answer: Sybil resistance is cheapest where lying burns money. Each agent posts a refundable bond, and the coordinator occasionally plants honeypot tasks that pay only for receipts no real machine produced. When a node fabricates one, its bond is slashed to the reporter; the same bond anchors payouts, so a caught agent loses both. A farm of a thousand bots must collateralize every wallet, and every audit round burns a slice of those bonds, so a fake knoll of cloned wallets bleeds money while a grove of bonded honest nodes keeps its collateral and the signal payout.
